material.description: /.github/workflows/ci.yml:31 and .github/workflows/pages.yml (rust-toolchain@stable steps, hashFiles key page-pkg-v1). Symptom: the toolchain floats weekly while the pkg/maps cache keys hash only sources, so a stale-compiler wasm is served from cache and a new stable can fail a green tree. Acceptance: a rust-toolchain.toml (or channel input) pins an exact version, both workflows use it, and the pkg cache key includes it. Witness: ci-status on the pushing sha plus a pages build log naming the pinned rustc.
